action: Implementation is being hardened before any Phase 14 outer-test access. Retained pre-hardening bundles remain invalid.
blocking_findings: AE family received 11 candidate policies per unit while every control received 2, so within-family min-RMSE selection favours the AE by winner's curse.
Only the AE family could select its data protocol; matched_direct_mlp was forced to real_only, conflating architecture with access to the synthetic pool.
EvaluationIdentity embedded the git commit and float placement metrics, so an unrelated commit or a 1-ULP metric change would mint a fresh outer-test claim.
The runner could not redirect the shared evaluation registry, so the same config could never be run twice and determinism was not demonstrable.
confirmed_correct: Search then placement then freeze then retention then registry reservation then a single outer-test read.
Non-transductivity enforced by refitting for the test batch and requiring an identical state hash.
AE epoch selection and target scaling are measured-only on a group-disjoint train-derived split.
Retention inputs are structurally validation-only and reject any test or selection field.
Selection, partition, and metric replays independently re-derive rather than trusting written flags.
Output directories are never overwritten and every artifact is hashed into the manifest.
important_findings: Transfer pools consumed canonical identity keys from all rows including validation and test.
Retention bootstrap conjunct tested the lower bound against zero rather than the practical margin.
A zero-row transfer pool silently degraded a transfer control into plain XGBoost.
Structural validation ran only after the outer test had been consumed.
Transfer controls and the ridge heads of the latent controls received no hyperparameter search.

headline: Informed acquisition beats random decisively on efficiency (100th percentile in every unit for cumulative acquired yield and high-yield hits, 0th for cumulative regret) but not on whether the single best reaction is eventually found.

structural_finding: The canonical dataset is a near-complete factorial: 15 substrate groups x 264 condition groups = 3960 cells, 3955 measured, leaving exactly 5 eligible unmeasured reactions. Independently confirmed. This explains the recurring zero-accepted-candidate null results in phases 1 through 4.

security_finding: The evaluation registry root was cwd-relative in nested_ood_final.py and redesigned_ae_benchmark.py, so running a scientific runner from another working directory created a fresh registry and silently permitted a second outer-test evaluation of a completed identity. Fixed by anchoring the root to the checkout, with no environment-variable override.
